name: Where is my order?
summary: Find the patient's most recent order and give a specific status and ETA.

sources.title: Why haven't I received my order yet? (Recurring order)
When will I receive my order? (Recurring)

steps.title: Verify identity
steps.instruction: Verify the patient with email and date of birth before sharing any order details.

steps.title: Find the order
steps.instruction: Call get_orders. If the patient has more than one active program and it is unclear which one they mean, give the status of each program's latest order briefly.

steps.title: Explain the status
steps.instruction: dispatched: give the carrier, tracking number and ETA. processing: the pharmacy is preparing it, usually 3-4 days after charging. on_hold: explain the hold reason and the exact action the patient needs to take. scheduled: give the date it will be created. delivered: give the delivery date.

steps.title: Late order check
steps.instruction: If the order was charged more than 7 days ago and is not delivered, or dispatched with an ETA in the past, escalate to support for a carrier investigation and tell the patient a team member will follow up.

eligibility.rule: Order details are only shared with a verified patient.

escalation.when: Order is late (more than 7 days since charge or past ETA and not delivered)
